config.favoriteitems.title: Favorite Items
config.favoriteitems.hotbar_indicator.to:
When the favorite icon appears
over a favorited hotbar slot.
config.favoriteitems.drop_favorites.tool:
Whether a favorited stack can be dropped.
Block: never.
Block Last Stack Item: stackable items are blocked
only when it would take their last item(s);
Ctrl+Q throws all but one.
Allow Stackable: stackable items can be dropped.
Allow Everything: always.
Non-stackable items are blocked
in every mode except Allow Everything.
config.favoriteitems.action_bar_notifica:
Shows a short message above the hotbar
when a favorite item or a protected tool
is blocked, and when a toggle key
switches a protection on or off.
config.favoriteitems.protect_enabled.too:
Blocks using a protected item in the world
(favorited or any, see "Protection Applies To").
Detailed settings: below.
Works independently of the
"Drop Favorites" setting.
config.favoriteitems.protect_scope.toolt:
Which items Additional Protection covers.
Stackable Items: only items that stack.
All Items: also tools, armor and other
items that do not stack.
config.favoriteitems.protect_target.tool:
Which items Additional Protection watches.
Favorites Only: items marked as favorite.
Any Item (No Mark Needed): every item in your
hands, with or without the favorite mark.
config.favoriteitems.custom_note:
Note: visit the mod page to learn
how to configure the Custom sound and Custom style.
config.favoriteitems.shadow_enabled.tool: Draws a shadow behind the icon layers.
config.favoriteitems.dyeable_enabled.too:
Draws the icon's dyeable layer,
which is tinted with the color below.
config.favoriteitems.dyeable_color.toolt: Multiplies the dyeable layer of the icon.
config.favoriteitems.static_enabled.tool:
Draws the icon's fixed-color detail layer,
which is never tinted.
config.favoriteitems.static_order.toolti:
Whether the static colors are drawn
on top of the dyeable layer,
or underneath it.
Only matters when both layers
are on the same side of the item.
config.favoriteitems.layer_position.tool:
Whether this layer is drawn on top of the item,
or underneath it.
config.favoriteitems.nothing_visible: Nothing would show on a favorited slot!
config.favoriteitems.protect_disabled_no:
Protection is off. Turn on "Additional Protection"
above to make these settings take effect.
config.favoriteitems.preset.tooltip:
The Active Preset:
the one used in-game after saving.
Pick a preset to see and edit its actions below.
config.favoriteitems.protect_actions.too:
No: not protected.
Last Item: only the final item of a favorited stack.
Full: the whole stack, any count.
Which items count: see "Protected Items".
Moving or dropping favorites is always locked.
config.favoriteitems.protect_action.plac:
Placing blocks, seeds, torches,
item frames, paintings and armor stands.
Dyes and ink sacs:
dyeing sheep, wolf collars,
signs, and so on.
Honeycomb: waxing copper blocks and signs.
config.favoriteitems.protect_action.thro:
Snowballs, eggs, ender pearls,
eyes of ender, bottles o' enchanting
and wind charges.
config.favoriteitems.protect_action.fire:
Launching firework rockets,
from a block or in the air (elytra).
config.favoriteitems.protect_action.shoo:
Drawing a bow or loading a crossbow
when the ammo it would use
is favorited arrow (or firework).
Not used with Infinity.
config.favoriteitems.protect_action.feed:
Feeding animals their food
(breeding, taming, healing pets).
Only count for items
animals accept.
config.favoriteitems.protect_action.use_:
Right-clicking a villager
or wandering trader
while holding the item,
which also opens trading.

Right-clicking any other mob or entity
with the item in hand: name tags, leads,
saddles, armor stands, piglin bartering,
giving the item to a mob (e.g. an allay), etc.
Dyes and food have their own rows.

Right-clicking chests,
crafting tables, furnaces, anvils
and other blocks that open a screen.

Right-clicking doors, trapdoors, fence gates,
buttons, levers, repeaters,
comparators, daylight detectors
and note blocks.

Right-clicking blocks
that react without a screen:
cauldrons, composters, beds,
campfires, cakes, flower pots,
respawn anchors, beehives, vaults and so on.
config.favoriteitems.protect_action.othe:
Any other right-click use
not listed above.
config.favoriteitems.protect_lists.toolt:
What each action covers.
Entries are IDs, #tags, mymod:*, * (everything)
or @group: a file from
config/favoriteitems/presets/groups/.
config.favoriteitems.protect_list.exclud: Exceptions to which this does not apply.
config.favoriteitems.protect_list.subjec:
The lists of this action match
the item in your hand.

The lists of this action match
the block you right-click.

The lists of this action match
the mob or entity you right-click.
config.favoriteitems.protect_list.syntax:
Matches the item in your hand
(the ammo, for shooting).

Matches the mob
or entity you right-click.

Entries: an ID (minecraft:lever),
a #tag (#minecraft:doors),
a whole mod (mymod:*)
or a group (@animals).
config.favoriteitems.protect_entry_unkno: No such group file in presets/groups: %s
config.favoriteitems.new_preset.tooltip:
On Save, creates a preset
with this name as a copy
of the preset selected above,
and makes it active.
Leave empty to skip.
config.favoriteitems.delete_preset.toolt:
Deletes the chosen preset on Save.
The built-in presets can't be deleted.
config.favoriteitems.reset_builtins.tool:
On Save, resets Build Protect, Soft Protect,
Full Protect and Custom to their defaults.
Presets you created yourself are not touched.
config.favoriteitems.preset_name_taken:
A preset with this name
already exists
config.favoriteitems.preset_name_too_lon:
Preset name is too long
(max %s characters)
config.favoriteitems.axe_protect.tooltip:
No stripping logs,
no scraping copper or removing wax.
config.favoriteitems.shovel_protect.tool:
No flattening grass into paths,
no putting out campfires.
config.favoriteitems.shears_protect.tool:
No shearing sheep, mooshrooms or snow golems,
no carving pumpkins, no taking honeycomb from hives,
no stopping the growth of kelp and vines,
no removing armor from your wolf.
config.favoriteitems.brush_protect.toolt:
No brushing suspicious sand or gravel,
no brushing scutes off armadillos.
config.favoriteitems.move_same_favorites:
What the "Move Same Items" buttons and keys of Nemo's
Inventory Sorting, Client Sort and Inventory Profiles Next
do with favorited stacks.
Stay in Place: favorites are left alone.
Move, Leave One: stackable favorites move out too, one item
staying in the favorite slot. Non-stackable favorites always stay.
Out of the player a favorite moves only if the container
already holds its item. Exceptions: IPN's Move All and Only
Focused Type ignore that, Just Refill fills existing stacks only.
Into the player, IPN tops up favorites that have room.
Client Sort always tops them up, whatever this is set to.
config.favoriteitems.ipn_refill_favorite:
Yes: IPN's auto refill never takes a favorite stack
from your inventory.
No: it may use favorite stacks to refill a slot.
config.favoriteitems.ipn_refill_last_ite:
Yes: when a favorite stack in your hand is down to its last item
and Protect would stop it from being used, IPN's auto refill
tops that stack up from another stack.
No: IPN's auto refill ignores the protected last item.
Needs Additional Protection and IPN's Auto Refill.
config.favoriteitems.lobby_favorites.too:
Yes: a favorite stays tied to its item, so when a server
moves you to a lobby (or swaps your inventory) your favorites
wait and come back together with the items. Also keeps
"Keep Favorites After Death" working after you reconnect.
No: a favorite is tied to its slot only and is
dropped as soon as that slot is empty.
config.favoriteitems.death_favorites.too:
Yes: after you die, the items you pick up near where you died
(within 5 minutes) get their favorite back, as many as you lost.
No: favorites are lost together with the dropped items.
config.favoriteitems.missing_cloth.messa: Install Cloth Config to open the mod settings.
